verdict.rationale: x402 has the client or agent sign each payment (and escrow limits in batch settlement), but nothing documents a user-facing approval step, human confirmation, or consent mandate before an agent's spend settles. x402.org advertises agent payments with "No signups or approvals required". Signed payment payloads and signed escrow limits are protocol mechanics executed by the paying signer; they are not documented user approval gates, so they count only as adjacent building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, sensitive agent spending requires my documented approval — a confirmation step, signed mandate, or per-purchase consent — before money moves
